readme.excerpt: Lemo-Opuscar 99 film styles for your coding agent. Pick one, bring your story, and the agent makes the film, entirely in code. 99 种影片风格，每种都配一支完全用代码做出来的短片 · 🇨🇳 中文用户请看 简体中文说明 ▶ Open the gallery · 中文画廊 Official repo: github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar · by Lemomo (@lemomo ai) [!IMPORTANT] This release was audited and improved with Claude Fable 5.2. Built for Claude. Claude Fable, Opus and Sonnet all work; set effort to high (in Claude Code, type `/effort high`). Other models may not reproduce the styles well, so use them with care. 🆕 New - 2026-11-12 · 33 new styles : 99 now, in 15 categories sorted by what the picture looks like, and the gallery in English and Chinese, with a page for every style. Some demo films remade, bugs fixed, style prompts improved. See the styles ↓ - 2026-10-22 · Make a style your own: change a style or start blank, and keep it. See how ↓ How it works 1. Pick a style. Browse the gallery by what the picture looks like, or search for what you are making: explainers, launches, news, music videos. 2. Watch its demo. Every style has a short film made in code, and a page with stills, what it suits and the `STYLE.md` your agent follows. 3. Ask your agent. Install the skill once, then say it in one sentence: Name the style in English or Chinese, or by its folder; the style index lists them all. Add a length, a narrator, your own photos or music if you like: Mak
